Full PnR exits 125: "Failed to find a route for arc 23 of net div_clk" after 24 "Failed to route ... using dedicated routing" warnings. Root cause measured: clknames_5ast138c defines 0 of the 16 {T,B,R,L}BDHCLK{0..3} names, so gw5_make_hclk_to_clk_gates never fires on this device and no HCLK->GCLK gate pip exists -- the CLKDIV output cannot reach a global spine. E0 NOT COMPUTED: the open side produces no .fs (gowin_pack on the --no-route JSON aborts with AttributeError get_BLOCKER_LUT_fuses), and apicula gowin_unpack decodes no CLKDIV cell from the vendor .fs either (138600 cells: DFF/IOB/LUT/BANK only), so an HCLK-scoped E0 would be vacuous on both sides.
